# Iner Studio — Full Product Description

## Overview

Iner Studio (by Pixel Software Design) is a comprehensive, free, browser-based 3D interior design and modular architecture application. It enables anyone — from professional interior designers to homeowners — to create, furnish, and visualize interior spaces in real-time 3D directly in their web browser. No installation required.

**URL:** https://iner.pixelsoftwaredesign.xyz/
**Access:** Free with account (login at https://iner.pixelsoftwaredesign.xyz/login)
**Technology:** Three.js, WebGL, vanilla JavaScript, Cloudflare Pages

## Core Features

### Room Design & Construction
- Build rooms from dimensions (width, depth, height)
- Import 2D floor plans from images, trace walls/doors/windows, and convert to 3D construction
- Modular architecture: rooms are composable, with walls, doors, windows, stairs as separate elements
- Real-time 3D viewport with orbit controls, quad view (front/top/left/perspective), and measurement tools

### Furniture Library
Iner Studio includes a large built-in library of parametric 3D furniture, organized by room type:
- **Living room:** Sofa, armchair, pouf, coffee table, TV unit, TV
- **Kitchen:** Fridge, oven, cooktop, washer
- **Dining:** Dining table, chairs
- **Bedroom:** Bed (queen), wardrobe, nightstand
- **Office:** Desk, bookshelf, office chair
- **Bathroom:** Toilet, sink, shower, bathtub
- **Structural:** Walls, doors, windows, door handles, window handles, curtains, stairs
- **Lighting:** Lamps, spotlights
- **Outdoor:** Plants, trees, flower pots, benches

### Materials & Styles
- 12+ built-in materials: paint (warm/cool), concrete, reinforced concrete, brick, oak, walnut, tile, glass, metal, fabric, ceramic
- Style presets: American, European, Industrial (concrete), Mediterranean
- Custom object color picker
- Terrain materials: grass, dirt, rock, snow, sand, brick, stone

### Terrain & Nature
- Create parametric terrain with configurable size and resolution
- Sculpt terrain: raise, lower, smooth, flatten with adjustable brush
- Scatter nature elements: grass, shrubs, rocks, trees

### 360° Panoramas
- Import HDR environment maps and 360° panoramic images
- Export your scene as a 360° panoramic image
- View your interior design in immersive VR-ready panoramas

### AI Assistant
- Built-in AI chat describes and generates rooms from natural language
- Example prompts: "Salon moderne 20m² avec canapé et table basse", "Cuisine ouverte 12m² avec îlot central"
- AI generates variant proposals to choose from

### Cinematic Timeline
- Record camera keyframes to create cinematic walkthroughs
- Object animation keyframes (position, rotation, scale)
- Loop playback, real-time time display
- Export animation as WebM video

### 3D Modeling Tools
- Move, rotate, scale with transform gizmos
- Sub-object editing: vertex, edge, face modes
- Boolean CSG operations (union, subtract, intersect)
- Mesh operations: subdivide, extrude, bevel, smooth, mirror, weld, collapse
- Array tool: linear, grid, circle, curve arrays
- Mirror, snap grid, measurement tool
- Object linking and clustering

### Import/Export
- Save/load .pix project files (JSON-based)
- Export OBJ (Wavefront)
- Export GLB (glTF Binary) — compatible with Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine
- Import GLB models

### Collaboration & Workflow
- Undo/redo with snapshots
- Object visibility toggling
- Scene hierarchy with collapsible tree
- Status bar with coordinates, mode display, and contextual hints

## Use Cases

1. **Interior Design:** Create a room, furnish it, apply materials, and visualize the result in 3D
2. **Home Renovation:** Import your floor plan, convert to 3D, test different furniture layouts
3. **Architecture Presentation:** Create cinematic walkthroughs of your design
4. **Real Estate Staging:** Quickly furnish empty rooms for client presentations
5. **Education:** Learn 3D design concepts in an accessible browser tool
6. **Modular Architecture:** Design modular spaces with composable elements

## Technical Specifications

- **Rendering:** WebGL with Three.js (real-time shadows, PBR materials)
- **Lighting:** HDR environment maps, ambient + directional lights
- **Performance:** Optimized for modern browsers, supports 60fps viewport
- **File Format:** .pix (JSON), OBJ, GLB
- **Platform:** Web (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- **Backend:** Cloudflare Pages with Workers (auth via KV storage)
